items.title: AM Best expects minimal reinsurance impact from French civil unrest
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that commentary from AM Best suggests the reinsurance impact of recent civil unrest in France will likely be small.

items.title: Healey to shield low-income pensioners from income tax in the Budget
items.summary: Pensioners on low incomes will be shielded from income tax by Chancellor John Healey in his first Budget on Wednesday, according to BBC reporting.

items.title: Schemes could be overpaying tax on DB surplus refunds, advisers say
items.summary: Pension schemes could be paying more tax than necessary on surplus payments to employers while trustees remain reluctant to launch a challenge, Professional Pensions reports.

items.title: ATE insurers likely to wait out Man City appeal before backing compensation claims
items.summary: Rival football clubs and players considering compensation claims against Manchester City may need to wait until the club's appeal concludes to secure after-the-event insurance, according to Insurance Business reporting.

items.title: AmTrust acquires Wakam weeks after French regulator halted underwriting
items.summary: Insurance Business reports that AmTrust International has acquired pan-European B2B2C insurer Wakam less than five weeks after French regulators suspended its underwriting.

items.title: Kinsale posts strong Q3 combined ratio despite net income decline
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Kinsale Capital Group recorded a strong third-quarter combined ratio of 75.4% for 2026, even as net income fell by roughly 30%.
